title: What Color Is the Lens Right Now?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hm... On the right? Left? At the back?
Where are the Machan goods?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That's strange, I don't see any. Maybe the
new products are
somewhere separate?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've come to the Umamusume merch shop
with Aston Machan to see if
they've made
any merch based on her, but...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hm... Guess they haven't made them yet.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But I appeared on that special TV show,
and I've made my debut, so
it shouldn't be
long before I'm on all the shelves.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I can't wait. I'll be Merry Machan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I don't think it'll be hard for
her to get her own merch.
But to have it
sold front and center in a shop like this...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, it'll be okay. Let's make sure I
get better and stay active
in races. If I we
keep it up, I'm sure I'll show up in lots of
people's
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And when I do, boop! My loveliness will
reach everyone in the
audience, and
everyone in their living rooms, and snuggle
up in their
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although her speech and mannerisms
make her seem soft and gentle
on the
outside, her determination is steadfast and
gritty.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: What is sad is being forgotten.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No matter what it takes, I want to make her wish come true. She will be remembered.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's about time to go home. What
are you looki—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wave goodbye to a puzzled Aston
Machan and hurry toward the
object that
caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? It's rare to see Trainer so worked up.
Hm...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'd seen a poster for a local craft shop
which said "Make your own DIY
fragrance
pouch!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look down at the small pouch I've made,
its design and colors based
on Aston
Machan's image. At the moment, there's
still no fragrance
inside it, though.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But I appeared on that special TV show,
and I've made my debut, so
it shouldn't be
long before I'm on all the shelves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
People who don't know her might think
that her obsession with merch
is frivolous,
but at the core of her wish is something
much deeper.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I became her trainer to make that wish
come true. And so I'll grab on
to any sliver
of hope, no matter how fleeting it may
seem.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This pouch is my prayer. It's not made well
enough to call merch, and
there's only one
of them, but still...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Are you talking about Machan's dream?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I was so curious where you were going, I
couldn't help but watch you.
So I
happened to see you enter that craft shop.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I saw you choose a fabric and some thread
and then sit down, plop.
You asked the
staff for lots of advice. You were a bit
nervous, weren't
you?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yep. Your face looked so serious from the
side. You snipped away...
snip, snip.
Before I knew it, I'd watched the whole
thing.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder why. I don't know. But the whole
time, I stood there as if I
was listening to
the waves.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That fragrance pouch is the same color as
Machan. It looks just like
me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It's like you created a whole new Machan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Far from impressive enough to qualify as
Machan merch, it's more just
a reminder of
my own wish.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You made a wish on it? Was it so you
wouldn't forget me? If you
didn't have that
pouch, would you forget about me?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's no good. We'll have to do
something about that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't tell if she's joking or not, but she
stares at me as if waiting for
an answer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't be more certain. Every
day—several times a day, even—I
think
about her training and how to achieve her
dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
How could I possibly forget about her?
When I look back over all the
memories
from our days together, and think about
the future...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You already remember, but still you look
back...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Remembering... looking back... recalling...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
They're different things. Being
remembered and being recalled. They

seem similar, but they're totally different.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You've committed me to your memory,
and you also recall me again
and again.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That doesn't stop. It continues, it repeats,
just like waves coming
ashore. Again and
again.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I feel... restless. Fidgety and wriggly. But
it's not a bad feeling.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That's strange. What is this? Wriggle,
wriggle. Hmmm?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She tilts her head in confusion, and I find
myself tilting mine too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She gets closer and looks intently at the
empty pouch in my hand.
Then, suddenly,
she pokes a finger at it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Please give me this fragrance pouch.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Machan wants it. Is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I give it another good look. I really don't
think it's good enough to be
a gift. If she
wants it, I should probably make her a new
one.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to. The first one you made
is special. Heh, I've got the
wrigglies
again.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Looking at it gives me that wriggly feeling.
Wriggle, wriggle. I wonder
what that's
about?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hand over the fragrance pouch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a look of curiosity and a hint of
delight, she fixes her eyes on it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She tilts her head a few times, examining
it, then turns to me. Her
gaze sinks deep
into my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Your lens always turns the color of the sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, she turns her back and
walks away.
